payload.description: A practical breakdown of what makes software survive the AI agent era. Using two real accounting software examples — Aiwyn and Double — CPA Jason Staats explains the key criteria for evaluating your current tools: do they offer MCP server support or at minimum a solid API? Firms that understand connectivity as the core requirement will pick tools that work with agents, not against them.
payload.name: How to AI-Proof Your Firm's Tech Stack
